Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: Misclassification of geographic region. The Planner incorrectly identified Da Nang as being in the "Southern region" of Vietnam. Da Nang is actually located in the South Central Coast region (Nam Trung Bộ), not the Southern region (Miền Nam), which typically includes the Central Highlands and the Mekong Delta. This error led to an incorrect final answer ("Southern Vietnam") instead of the correct answer ("South Central Coast").
